decisions.quote: we need to engage in long-term planning and stop crisis management

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Music transportation proposed for cuts in balanced budget
budget_items.quote: there won't be an athletic transportation, there won't be a music transportation cut

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Full-time athletic trainer position proposed for elimination
budget_items.quote: not having a trainer here full-time is a massive detriment to our program here at the school

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fifth grade music teacher position proposed for elimination
budget_items.quote: there won't be a point to music teacher at the fifth grade

budget_items.what_was_recorded: First grade proposed to reduce from five classrooms to four, increasing class sizes from approximately 23 to 30+ students
budget_items.quote: the proposed change from five first grade classrooms of approximately 23 students each to four classrooms of 30 students or more each
